title: Section 141 NI Act — Offences by companies

content.overview: Section 141 attributes cheque-dishonour liability to every person who, at the time the offence was committed, was in charge of and responsible to the company for the conduct of its business, and to the company itself, with defences for persons who prove due diligence or lack of knowledge.
content.study: Plead specific averments that the accused was in charge of and responsible for the company's business; directors are not automatically liable by designation alone. Sub-section (2) covers directors, managers, secretaries or other officers when the offence is committed with their consent, connivance, or attributable negligence. Pair with sections 138 and 142 when the drawer is a company or firm.
